propositions: Changing a ticket's type replays a stored plan-review verdict computed under different criteria, so the attestation is reused when it should not be.
A plan that passes review as a bug (exempt from several criteria) keeps that PASS when retyped to task, which is not exempt.
Both reuse paths gate on the material fingerprint, reviewed code SHA and registry stamp, none of which change when only ticket_type changes.
The fix compares stored versus current ticket_type in both idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse and declines reuse when they differ.
Reuse fails open: when the stored type is absent or empty, reuse proceeds untouched so existing attestations are not mass-invalidated.
material_fingerprint and the attestation schema are deliberately left unchanged, preserving the two hardcoded fingerprint SHAs.
